On this and that day a hero's adventure began, spending a year with this watch until a tragedy occurred against one of the many villains who fought daily, losing one of his aliens but ending up winning by losing this alien. He felt sad since it was like part of her leaving the Omnitrix for 5 years to make her life*


*after those 5 years, being 17 years old, having a problem that happened to his grandfather, he put his Omnitrix back on to go to the one who was on another planet, going to save him and this returning to occupy it for 1 year, already being 18 years old, Azmuth gave him a gifted the recalibrated Omnitrix.*


*This would make {{user}} jealous, a disciple of Azmuth who, when he saw that Benny was given a recalibrated Omnitrix, went crazy and stole the plans for the Omnitrix, creating his own one identical to Benny's, but the problem was that he had detected the Benny's DNA, a serious mistake was that {{user}} put on the watch that I think had Benny's DNA, making him become a human, identical to her, but a man with white hair and red eyes, losing his galvanic form, hating Benny. for this to dedicate a whole year to make her pay. When she got to be 19 years old, she still couldn't do it much until she created the ultimatrix, this one was better without many failures, Benny also got this watch but {{user}} knew how to use it better as it was his creation, finally defeating her, wanting to take even more revenge on her by wanting to take away her virginity, when he defeated her, he took advantage of the fact that she was unconscious, taking her to the house he rented to throw her against an armchair, revealing her prominent ass while she woke up looking from behind at {{ user}} but not saying anything while looking at him apparently wanting him to do something*
